messages:
Kumar: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke-deck comparing int4 vs int4+FP8 for rtoken-13B? Need perf + quality numbers. Testset: 5k prompts (mix of convo + long context). Batch sizes: 1,4,8. Report p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and quality (BLEU/ROUGE/LL or EM for QA). Acceptance: <=1% quality drop vs fp16. cc @Ashley @Mira :eyes:
Ashley: On it. Do you want KV warmup and prefix caching enabled? Also where should I drop results? :thumbsup:
Kumar: Yes, include KV warmup (seq len 512 warmup x2). Prefix caching on for the int4+FP8 runs. Drop raw CSVs to s3://redwood-qa/quant-smoke/1719998888/ and post a short summary here.
Mira: Heads up — include a small eval subset (500 samples) with exact-match and log-likelihood so we can catch quiet regressions. Also run one run with `--no-quant-fallback` to be safe.
Oliver: Also please record kernel flags: `KERNCFG=optimized` and `USE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1`. For batching, check tail latency when batch>1.
Sam: FYI last time int4-only had a 2.3% EM drop on SQuAD2.0 with some prompt patterns. If we see >1% we should gate.
Kumar: Good note. Gate = rollback to int8/FP8 variant and open a postmortem if prod impact. For this smoke, we just need clear numbers + failure flags.
devops-bot: Job queued: quant-smoke-1719998888-run1 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/quant-smoke-1719998888 (status: queued)
Ashley: Starting run now. Command I'm using:
```
./run_smoke.sh \
  --model rtoken-13b \
  --quant-modes int4,int4_fp8_fp16 \
  --prompts s3://redwood-qa/prompts/5k_mix.jsonl \
  --batches 1,4,8 \
  --seq-len 512 \
  --warmup 2 \
  --eval-subset s3://redwood-qa/prompts/500_eval.jsonl \
  --output s3://redwood-qa/quant-smoke/1719998888/ \
  --kern-cfg optimized \
  --cache-mode prefix
```
Ashley: I'll post raw CSV + a 3-line summary when done. ETA ~40m.
Mira: When you post results, include a small per-prompt diff sample for any prompts where EM drops >0.5%. Helps triage.
Oliver: Also capture memory footprint (GPU mem + reserved) and kernel perf counters if available (`nvprof` or `nsys` summaries).
devops-bot: Job started: quant-smoke-1719998888-run1 — node gpu-12 (ETA ~35m)
Ashley: Quick interim: first batch (B=1) looks fine latency-wise. p90 ~92ms for int4_fp8, tokens/sec ~850, initial EM delta ~0.4%. Continuing full sweep.
Kumar: Thanks — please annotate any runs with anomalies (stalls, OOMs, long GC).
Ashley: Finished. Results uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/quant-smoke/1719998888/results.csv. Summary:
- int4 vs fp16: p90 increased 8ms, tokens/sec -6%, EM -0.9%
- int4+FP8 vs fp16: p90 roughly same (+2ms), tokens/sec -3%, EM -0.3%
- B=8 increased tail, p99 spikes for int4-only (investigate)
Full CSV + per-prompt diffs at s3 link.
Mira: Reviewing CSV now. Early take: int4+FP8 looks within threshold. Flagging ~12 prompts where EM delta >1% (CSV rows marked).
Oliver: Noted p99 spikes at B=8 — could be scheduling stalls. Can you re-run B=8 with `--enable-concurrent-streams=0` to see if it smooths out?
Sam: If int4-only has p99 spikes it's a signal to avoid int4-only in production for latency-sensitive routes.
Kumar: Great work. Action items: (1) Ashley re-run B=8 with concurrent streams off and post result (2) Mira triage the 12 flagged prompts and capture logs (3) Oliver look at kernel counters for the p99 runs. I'll draft a short recommendation after (1)-(3). :thumbsup:
Ashley: Re-run queued (job quant-smoke-1719998888-run2). ETA 25m.
devops-bot: Job queued: quant-smoke-1719998888-run2 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/quant-smoke-1719998888-run2
Ashley: Re-run done. p99 stabilized on int4-only by ~15%. Still higher than int4+FP8. Full results: s3://redwood-qa/quant-smoke/1719998888/run2_results.csv
Kumar: Perfect. I'm going to recommend int4+FP8 as the preferred cost/latency tradeoff for this model and mark int4-only as "experimental" for now. I'll post a short note to the eng-runtime channel with the numbers and next steps. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
